sections.heading: Bandwidth ordering
sections.text: Inner current loop crossover: f_ci ~ fsw/10. Outer voltage loop crossover: f_cv ~ f_ci/5 to f_ci/3. This ensures the current loop settles before the voltage loop acts. The current loop handles the fast inductor dynamics.

sections.heading: Gain direction
sections.text: For the current loop: increase kp until the current tracks the reference within one switching cycle, then add ki for zero steady-state error. For the voltage loop: increase kp for faster transient response, increase ki for lower steady-state voltage error.

sections.heading: Slope compensation
sections.text: If D > 0.5 at any operating point, add slope compensation with ramp slope >= inductor downslope / 2. Without it, subharmonic instability occurs near fsw/2. The ramp is added to the current sense signal.

sections.heading: Sample time
sections.text: Current loop sample time: <= 1/(10*fsw). Voltage loop sample time: can be slower, <= 1/(5*fsw). The current loop needs faster sampling to catch the peak current accurately.

sections.heading: Operating-point sensitivity
sections.text: The plant gain varies with input voltage (D changes with Vin). At maximum Vin, D is smallest and the plant gain is lowest. Verify current-loop stability at both Vin_min and Vin_max.
